correctness.developer_gates: actual selected relevant units every repeated run, unchanged scorer/thresholds
correctness.source: candidate image differs only in its designated hypothesis files

performance.metric: median full Docker State lifetime, warmup/profile excluded
performance.primary_requirement: at least 5% time reduction on every declared primary unit
performance.regression_guardrail: no median slowdown over 5% on any selected unit
performance.component: diagnostic only, not an adoption basis
performance.statistical_scope: preliminary workload-specific local evidence; overlapping ranges and inconsistent pairs explicitly reported; no robust general or official performance claim
